name: Rime's Wrath

angles.text: As a shaman, you know how dangerous an unbridled elemental like Avala can be. Its turmoil changes the weather and shakes the stone. Calming such beings helps restore harmony among the elements.
As a paladin, you protect travelers and common folk from sudden calamity. The observer invokes the Light's blessing in gratitude for the deaths you helped prevent.

faq.answer: An observer asks you to hunt Avala, a great elemental that appeared after a rockslide, and bring back its core. Avala brings erratic weather and more slides to the mountain pass.

Avala is a particularly large elemental that appeared after a major rockslide. It brings sudden weather changes, freezing chills, and dangerous tremors to the area. The observer watching the pass gave Avala its name.

Avala brings unpredictable weather and rockslides to the nearby slopes. If it remains, its influence over winter weather and the land could cause further collapses and kill travelers crossing the pass.
faq.q: Why does Avala need to be destroyed?

faq.answer: The observer asks you to bring back Avala's core after defeating it. The core proves the elemental is dead and the threat has ended.
faq.q: What proof is needed to complete Rime's Wrath?

faq.answer: Avala appeared after an initial rockslide disrupted the region. Other elementals surfaced too, but Avala was the largest and most dangerous among them.

A local observer near the dangerous mountain pass calls on capable champions to stop Avala. After watching the rockslide and the elementals appear, the observer seeks to prevent needless deaths. When the work is done, the observer invokes the Holy Light's blessing.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Rime's Wrath?

faq.answer: After Avala dies and you return its core, the severe weather swings and tremors ease. The observer blesses you in the Light and gives you a reward, saying the pass is safer for travelers.
faq.q: What happens after Avala is defeated?

sections.body: A rockslide has unsettled the mountain pass, and elementals have appeared. One is far larger and stronger than the others. The observer watching the pass named it Avala. Its power brings sudden weather shifts and shakes the cliffs. Loose stone and bitter winter chills now make the pass perilous for travelers.
sections.title: The Wake of the Rockslide

sections.body: Avala's influence makes the pass more dangerous. The observer calls on you to stop it before more collapses claim lives. You face the elemental amid the harsh conditions it stirs, then bring back its core as proof of its death. With Avala gone, the violent weather shifts ease, and the mountain passes grow safer for travelers.
sections.title: Quelling Avala

summary: After a rockslide, Avala makes the mountain pass dangerous. An observer asks you to hunt the great elemental and bring back its core, so the slopes may grow safer for travelers.
